name: Hugging Face Inference API
tagline: Run open models for text, images, audio, and embeddings via HTTP
description: Hugging Face Inference API (Serverless) lets developers call open models hosted on the Hugging Face Hub for generation, embeddings, classification, and multimodal tasks without managing GPUs. Authenticate with a user access token; responses are JSON (or binary for some media tasks). Pricing and limits depend on account plan and model size; free usage is rate-limited and may queue under load.

auth.details: HF user access token via Authorization: Bearer <token> header; create tokens at huggingface.co/settings/tokens

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — free tier exists but exact request quotas need verification from current pricing page

example.response_snippet: [{"generated_text": "Hello world, this is a sample continuation..."}]

use_cases: run text generation with an open LLM on the Hub
compute sentence embeddings for semantic search
classify text sentiment or zero-shot labels
generate images from text with a diffusion model
transcribe audio with a speech-to-text model
